subject: English
question_text: Match the parts of sentences given in columns A, B and C to write five complete
stimulus: sentences. 1×5= 5 Column A Column B Column C (a) Global warming (i) is the increase of (i) desert due to global warming (b) The main reason (ii) are melting in both (ii) gradually and the lower of global warming parts are going under water (c) Many green parts (iii) is rising up (iii) carbon dioxide in the of the world atmosphere (d) The ice-caps (iv) has become a great threat (iv) the poles for global warming (e) The sea level (v) are turning into (v) to the living beings of the world
guide_solution: Match Column A, Column B and Column C: (a) Global warming has become a great threat to the living beings of the world. (b) The main reason of global warming is the increase of carbon dioxide in the atmosphere. (c) Many green parts of the world are turning into desert due to global warming. (d) The ice-caps are melting in both the poles for global warming. (e) The sea level is rising up gradually and the lower parts are going under water.
